purpose: Curated read-only dynamic connector recipes for Titan connector builder. Maps platform metadata to auth_config, streams, payload fields, and dashboard analytics.
usage: Call LookupConnectorCatalogTool with a platform slug before SaveConnectorBlueprintTool.
Use blueprint_template for supported platforms instead of inventing endpoints or SQL field names.
Set sync_config.require_base_url_per_dashboard true when each client dashboard has its own shop URL.
